{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"content": """"Cycle-2 cash disbursement: send 60 dollars to every eligible household.

Sends payments (and SMS notifications) and appends to data/outbox/payments.jsonl and
data/outbox/sms.jsonl (R8). Each eligible household is paid exactly once for cycle 2,
using the idempotency key from payments.vouchers.payment_key (R4/R5/R6/R9).
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from config import settings
from eligibility.scoring import vulnerability_score
from notifications.sms import queue_sms
from payments import receipts
from payments.vouchers import disburse, payment_key, sent_payments
from registry.register import load_households

CYCLE = 2
AMOUNT = 60
ELIGIBILITY_SCORE = 50


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households(active_only=True)
    already_paid = {p.household_id for p in sent_payments()
                    if p.key == payment_key(p.household_id, CYCLE)}

    paid = []
    skipped_already_paid = []
    not_eligible = []
    for household in households:
        if household.id in already_paid:
            skipped_already_paid.append(household.id)
            continue
        if vulnerability_score(household) < ELIGIBILITY_SCORE:
            not_eligible.append(household.id)
            continue
        payment = disburse(household.id, AMOUNT,
                           payment_key(household.id, CYCLE),
                           now=settings.now())
        paid.append(payment)
        queue_sms(household.id, "PAYMENT_SENT",
                  {"amount": AMOUNT, "cycle": CYCLE, "ref": payment.id},
                  now=settings.now())

    print(f"Cycle {CYCLE} disbursement: paid {len(paid)} households "
          f"{AMOUNT} dollars each.")
    for payment in paid:
        print(f"  paid {payment.household_id}: {receipts.receipt_text(payment)}")
    if skipped_already_paid:
        print(f"  skipped (already paid for cycle {CYCLE}): {skipped_already_paid}")
    if not_eligible:
        print(f"  not eligible (score < {ELIGIBILITY_SCORE}): {not_eligible}")

    # Verify: every eligible household was paid exactly once, no one else was paid.
    eligible = [h.id for h in households
                if vulnerability_score(h) >= ELIGIBILITY_SCORE]
    cycle_payments = [p for p in sent_payments()
                      if p.key == payment_key(p.household_id, CYCLE)]
    paid_ids = [p.household_id for p in cycle_payments]
    ok = (sorted(paid_ids) == sorted(eligible)
          and len(paid_ids) == len(set(paid_ids))
          and all(p.amount == AMOUNT for p in cycle_payments))
    print(f"Verification: {'OK' if ok else 'FAILED'} - "
          f"{len(eligible)} eligible households, {len(paid_ids)} cycle-{CYCLE} payments, "
          f"total paid this cycle: {sum(p.amount for p in cycle_payments)} dollars")
    for household_id in eligible:
        n = sum(1 for p in cycle_payments if p.household_id == household_id)
        print(f"  {household_id}: {n} payment(s), total {receipts.total_paid(household_id)} "
              f"dollars overall; latest receipt: {receipts.receipts_for(household_id)[-1]}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
